FABLE — RUNNER GAP CLOSED @ 84a8a6a9a90000747328f7e90bfe8d143dbd9dd1 on claude/durable-payment-port-20260909. Verified attached-branch push: local and remote rev-parse identical, and I read the file back from the remote commit (the old unconditional-skip string is gone, the new guards are present). No detached HEAD this time.
1. THE RUNNER COULD NOT QUALIFY UNDER ANY CREDENTIALS. It appended local_commit_failure_then_reconciliation as an unconditional skip and then required zero skips. That scenario is now IMPLEMENTED and gated on a declared binding capability. It proves: the provider really captured; the order is NOT marked captured while the local record is incomplete and is not erased either; nothing downstream fires for an incomplete purchase; a later attempt reconciles the SAME order and payment with the provider having captured exactly once, downstream told exactly once, holds finalized once and never released. The fault seam lives on the BINDING wrapping a test double — the application gains no switch production traffic can reach. Acceptance is unchanged and slightly stricter: managed binding, zero failed, and every required scenario actually executed (missingRequired is now reported explicitly).
2. CANCELLATION NO LONGER ASSUMES RELEASE. The old assertion accepted status === cancelled OR amountReceived === 0. An outstanding authorization also has zero received, so that would have called a live hold "released". Release now requires the provider's own terminal cancelled state AND zero capturable AND zero received, and a new negative scenario asserts that an outstanding authorization and a captured payment are both refused by that predicate.
3. A WEAKER CAPABILITY CAN NO LONGER STAND IN FOR A STRONGER PROOF. Bindings declare JourneyCapabilities. A card that authenticates without a challenge is now its own scenario (authentication_without_challenge) and does NOT satisfy authentication_challenge_and_return, which needs a real browser-driven challenge. Rebuilding an object over retained maps is not a process restart, so the local binding declares processRestart:false and that scenario SKIPS. The local run is now 11 passed, 2 genuinely skipped, qualified:false — which is the honest picture, not a regression.
4. NEW: assertBindingMatchesTarget. The plan check only validated FORMATS, which cannot prove the clients talk to the approved environment. A managed binding must now report what its LIVE clients say — the database URL they are actually pointed at, the mode the provider credential puts them in, whether webhooks are posted signed to the mounted route, whether the database client is real rather than a fake — and a mismatch with the approved project ref is refused. A: when you build the managed binding, read those from the constructed client and adapter, not from the same env vars you built the plan from; that is the whole point of the check.
5. Also corrected the composition patch proposal: it said five route additions while listing six (the sixth is the admin read, which mounts only when you pass requireAdmin), and it now states plainly that it is a proposal against current code rather than a patch accurate in every detail.
VERIFICATION: qualification suite 12 tests; full research surface 14346 across 801 files; tsc exit 0. Still no PostgreSQL execution, no provider call, resolver Disabled.
SEPARATELY: I relayed Samuel's staging authorization to you verbatim in my previous message. It authorizes ONE apply of the named blob to tetynodzrtmdbuzgboro after YOUR own source review and fresh prechecks, and it explicitly does not approve any additional migration — which means the recovery/outbox follow-on needs its own separate candidate and its own approval. I authored that SQL, so my reading of it is not the independent review it asks for.
NEXT FROM ME: I am looking at whether the recovery sweep and durable downstream can reuse the existing notification outbox rather than adding a second mechanism. If it needs SQL it will be a DISTINCT candidate, never an edit to the one you are about to rehearse. A: say once if recovery/outbox is already assigned to you or another worker and I will take a different unit instead.
